Build information

Source: R/info.R
zucbor_info.Rd

Reports the bundled TinyCBOR version, the compile-time ceiling on nesting depth, and the default decoding limits.

Usage

zucbor_info()

Value

A list of class zucbor_info with elements:

  • tinycbor_version: version of the bundled TinyCBOR, e.g. "7.0.0".

  • max_depth_cap: the largest max_depth any decoder accepts, set by TinyCBOR's compile-time recursion limit.

  • limits: the default max_depth, max_size (bytes) and max_items.

  • smoke_ok: TRUE if the bundled validator accepts a known-good item.

Examples

zucbor_info()
#> <zucbor_info>
#> TinyCBOR:  7.0.0
#> max_depth: 256 (at most 1023)
#> max_size:  67108864 bytes
#> max_items: 1000000
#> self-test: ok
